transitions.rules: Step i (1-based, counting path steps first) uses messageId '00000000-0000-4000-8000-' + i zero-padded to 12 digits and timestamp 1741000000 + i. 'to' is the other party unless given. Matrix/path bodies come from bodyTemplates: '$head' = messageId of the latest history entry, '$beforeHead' = the one before it ('' when absent). A failing step does not change state. Run the matrix with local = buyer and again with local = seller; results are identical.
